### Valvoline Inc. Kicks Off Annual Children’s Miracle Network® Fundraising Campaign


November 2, 2026


*Customers can support their local children’s hospital across participating network locations throughout November.*


LEXINGTON, Ky.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV), the quick, easy, trusted leader in preventive automotive maintenance *,* today kicked off its annual in-store fundraising campaign benefiting Children’s Miracle Network. Throughout November, customers at participating Valvoline Instant Oil Change, Great Canadian Oil Change, and Oil Changers locations can donate to support children and families in their local communities.


This year marks Valvoline Inc.’s 17th year supporting Children’s Miracle Network, a partnership that began in 2009. Throughout the partnership, Valvoline Inc. and its customers have contributed nearly $10 million to support children’s hospitals through its fundraising efforts.


“Supporting the communities we serve is an important part of who we are at Valvoline Inc.,” said Lori Flees, President and CEO, Valvoline Inc. “For 17 years, our team members and customers have helped make a difference for children and families through Children’s Miracle Network. We’re proud to continue that tradition and invite our customers to join us again this year.”


Customers who visit participating service centers during the campaign can donate to Children’s Miracle Network, with 100% of the proceeds benefiting the local children’s hospital. As a thank-you, customers who donate will receive a 10% off coupon for a future service. Anyone can support the campaign with an online donation at[https://www.helpmakemiracles.org/Valvoline2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.helpmakemiracles.org%2FValvoline2026&esheet=54632384&newsitemid=20261102281123&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.helpmakemiracles.org%2FValvoline2026&index=1&md5=087a8a8bfddff8c4e9672b1809666818)


"Valvoline Inc. team members and customers prove what is possible when a community rallies around local children’s hospitals,” said Aimee Daily, Ph.D., President & CEO of Children’s Miracle Network. “Their generosity provides care teams with essential resources and gives families hope when it is needed most. We are grateful for Valvoline Inc.’s continued partnership as we launch this campaign and work together to make big change for all kids."


Children’s Miracle Network raises funds to support member children’s hospitals across the U.S. and Canada, helping provide care to millions of children and families each year.


**About Valvoline Inc.**


Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV) delivers quick, easy, trusted service at more than 2,500 franchised and company-operated service centers across the United States and Canada. The Company completes more than 30 million services annually system-wide, from about 15-minute stay-in-your-car oil changes to a variety of manufacturer-recommended maintenance services such as wiper replacements and tire rotations. At Valvoline Inc., it all starts with our people, including the over 13,500 team members who are working to drive the full potential of our core business, deliver sustainable network growth and innovate to meet the evolving needs of our customers and the car parc. For more information, visit[vioc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.vioc.com%2F&esheet=54632384&newsitemid=20261102281123&lan=en-US&anchor=vioc.com&index=2&md5=f579ac73ec35f88cc65227a4269416aa) .

**About Children’s Miracle Network**


For more than 40 years, Children’s Miracle Network® has been a symbol of hope, elevating possibilities for every child in need of care. As the leading charity impacting children’s healthcare, we unite people, partners and programs to raise urgently needed funds for children’s hospitals across the U.S. and Canada.


Wherever you see our iconic balloon, you’ll find donors, corporate partners and fundraising programs joining forces to help hospitals meet their most critical needs—from life-changing care and advanced equipment to innovative research and family support. Every dollar raised benefits the local children’s hospital, bringing brighter futures within reach for all kids.


Learn more at[cmn.org](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fcmn.org%2F&esheet=54632384&newsitemid=20261102281123&lan=en-US&anchor=cmn.org&index=3&md5=1f540d9c7cd6c247f26dfd7c499c7bf1) .
